title: Cooking With Choi
description:
S01 E01 — Kimchi Time
Esther Choi teaches how to make two types of kimchi, a fast Mak Kimchi that's ready in just days, as well as Halmoni's Kimchi, her grandmother's recipe; plus, Esther shares how to make Kimchi Fried Rice and bossam, Korean Pork Belly Wraps.

title: Cooking With Choi
description:
S01 E02 — Late Night Bites
Esther Choi shares some Korean street food classics, starting with extra crispy Korean Fried Chicken with Pickled Yuja Daikon; she also shows how to make Tteokbokki, chewy rice cakes simmered in a spicy sauce, and Gimmari, crispy seaweed rolls.

title: Cooking With Choi
description:
S01 E03 — Korean Burger Time
Choi makes her popular Korean Burger recipe with a side of Broccoli with Crumbled Tofu. Then, Esther rounds out the meal with Hotteok, a crispy doughnut with a gooey apple center that can be enjoyed on its own or with a Gochujang Caramel sauce.

title: Cooking With Choi
description:
S01 E04 — Korean BBQ
Esther Choi makes some favorite Korean classics; first, she picks the perfect flanken-cut short ribs for her Korean barbecue dish of LA Kalbi with Ssamjang; Esther's hot pot dish, Bulgogi Mushroom Jeongol, is all about savory bulgogi flavor.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S14 E11 — Crazy-Sweet Treats
Super s'mores and stunning marbled, dipped apples; deep-fried cheesecake bites with strawberry sauce; hard candy shot glasses topped up with fizz.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S18 E04 — Sweet School Treats
Ree Drummond makes divine chocolate treats for her daughter, Paige, to share with her school friends, and she sneaks in a few for her husband, Ladd, at the same time.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S23 E10 — Sweet Talk
Ree Drummond celebrates the opening of her new sweet shop with a lineup of treats and sundaes; she makes an old-fashioned Jeweled Divinity and shares the secrets to two of the over-the-top sundaes.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S30 E02 — Quick and Easy Sweet Treats
Ree Drummond makes sweet treats, starting with a puff pastry braid filled with nuts and chocolate spread; she also makes 4-berry chimichangas, cake mix bars packed with candies and mint-flavored icebox sandwiches.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S36 E05 — Short and Sweet
Ree Drummond makes super-fast sweets with easy shortcuts; she stacks a showstopping layered tiramisu cake, serves up a stunning sticky bun crinkle cake, creates a charming cherry chocolate mug cake and scoops fruity blackberry lemon ice cream.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S40 E07 — No Cook Sweets 4 Ways
Ree Drummond is sharing a selection of sweets with no cooking required, including a showstopping Whiskey Peach Icebox Pie, a shortcut Lemon Pudding Bowl, Iced Coffee Pops and bite-sized Chocolate Peanut Butter Dates.

title: Be My Guest With Ina Garten
description:
S08 E03 — Yotam Ottolenghi
Chef and restaurateur Yotam Ottolenghi joins Ina Garten to talk about his deli success and the secrets to his recipes; Ina welcomes him with coconut cupcakes and Yotam takes over the kitchen to make his traybake chicken.

title: Be My Guest With Ina Garten
description:
S07 E04 — Michael Barbaro
Journalist Michael Barbaro joins Ina Garten for Spicy Hermit Bars and conversation about storytelling tactics, style and the success of his podcast "The Daily"; Ina shows Michael an updated Chicken Marbella that's perfect for easy entertaining.

title: The Kitchen
description:
S16 E03 — Sweet Surprises
Valentine's Day food, crafts and sweet surprises; hidden heart cake; food-inspired Valentines; snack mix brownies; sour cream swirl brownies; a box of chocolates cake; pasta pomodoro; Mamrie Hart's French kiss 75 cocktail.

title: The Kitchen
description:
S38 E06 — Dreamy Desserts
The Kitchen serves up over-the-top desserts; Jeff Mauro starts off with Chocolate Cherry Cupcakes; Sunny Anderson whips up an Easy No-Bake Chocolate Cookie Cheesecake; Geoffrey Zakarian creates a light-as-air Raspberry and Cream Concorde Cake.

title: Guy's Grocery Games
description:
S11 E01 — Halloween Spook-tacular
The chefs must use tiny jack-o'-lanterns to grab all the ingredients to make a tricked-out treat; chefs wear blindfolds to find the key item for their dinners to die for; chefs can only use their bare hands to shop for a mummified dish.

title: Guy's Grocery Games
description:
S14 E10 — Guy's Ghostly Games
Including Guy Fieri's red fright special in their creepy comfort food dish; making a midnight snack using only ingredients they can fit in a tiny trick-or-treat bucket; featuring spooky ingredients in a haunted high-end dinner.

title: Guy's Grocery Games
description:
S18 E21 — Flavortown Fright Night
Four fearless chefs play Guy's scary games for a stab at a $20,000 shopping spree; Guy gives chefs a frightening ingredient that they must feature in a spicy dish; remaining chefs must choose what to cook using spooky menu-item refrigerator magnets.

title: Halloween Cookie Challenge
description:
S01 E03 — Halloween Cookie Party!
Festive Halloween masks made from cookies and edible party banners that incorporate classic Halloween candies.

title: Halloween Cookie Challenge
description:
S01 E04 — Are You Afraid of the Dark Cookie?
Four top cookie makers emerge from the shadows with spooky silhouette cookies; using orange-colored ingredients to craft 3D treats depicting jack-o'-lanterns.

title: Halloween Cookie Challenge
description:
S02 E01 — Day After Halloween and Ancient Coffin
It's the day after Halloween, and four talented bakers show Duff Goldman and Rosanna Pansino how the creepers take time to relax; the three remaining cookiers try to bury the competition by making 3D ancient coffins with mummified ingredients.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S16 E05 — Back from the Dead: Nightmare Pet Shop
Monstrous pets take over as Jonathan Bennett challenges the teams to create haunted pet shop showpieces and pumpkin-infused desserts; a surprise carving battle puts the teams to the test before judges Shinmin Li and Andrew Fuller make their decision.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S16 E06 — Back from the Dead: Final Four
As the race to the finale heats up, Jonathan Bennett challenges the final four teams to create terrifying toys and elevated treats inspired by childhood favorites; judges Shinmin Li and Andrew Fuller decide which teams earn a pass to the finale.

title: Halloween Baking Championship

The last four recruits face off in a Shakespeare-inspired culinary showdown to earn their spot in the ultimate cook-off; in the last skill drill, it's every recruit for themselves as red takes on red and blue goes head-to-head with blue.

description:

Ree Drummond is hoping to score big with dinner for the boys after quarterback training.

Ree Drummond downsizes dinner now that all her kids are grown and gone; she makes a small but scrumptious sausage and peppers 1/4 sheet pan pizza, and just the right amount of creamy pesto pasta.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:

Ree Drummond cleans out her kitchen by turning leftovers into dishes; she transforms her pantry and fridge odds and ends into Brown Sugar Buttermilk Waffles and more.

description:
S26 E02 — "Sweater Weather" Weeknight Warrior
Meals that are cozy for the cool weather such as harissa and fennel marinated lamb chops with tapenade, green curry with shrimp, turkey meatloaf with cranberry ketchup glaze, Tex-Mex chili mac skillet.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S15 E03 — The Scary Square-off
Jonathan Bennett asks the five teams to create a scene of two monsters playing various sports while highlighting the sugar artist's skill in their display; judges Shinmin Li and Aarti Sequeira evaluate the designs and one team is eliminated.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S15 E04 — Halloween Word Games
Bennett challenges the four remaining teams to create scenes based on three words; the pumpkin artists are in the spotlight as their monster must be completely made of pumpkin; judges Shinmin Li and Aarti Sequeira decide which teams move on.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S15 E05 — The Boogeyman's Lair
Host Bennett challenges seven teams of international cake, sugar and pumpkin artists to create spooky displays, complete with mouthwatering treats; judges Shinmin Li and Aarti Sequeira decide which team will walk away with $25,000.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S15 E06 — Spellbound
The final two teams create modern spell-casting scenes that include one special effect and three complete characters; it's up to Jonathan Bennett, Shinmin Li and Aarti Sequeira to decide who will be crowned Halloween Wars champion and win $25,000.

description:

Alex Guarnaschelli and singer Josh Groban hit the high notes and raise up their chefs, Thomas Youell and Diego Sanchez, to grill Bobby Flay in his own kitchen.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:

Alex Guarnaschelli and Jeff Mauro of "The Kitchen" aim to take down Bobby Flay; chefs Kathy Fang and Natascha Hess get into a pickle with the star ingredient.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:
S32 E09 — This Is How We (Kati) Roll
The View's Sunny Hostin and Christian Petroni rock Bobby Flay with a kati roll challenge; chefs Romain Paumier and Avishar Barua roll up to Bobby's kitchen.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:
S33 E11 — A Matcha Made in Heaven
Pastry chef Stephanie Boswell and actress Anika Noni Rose see chefs Lindsey Farr and Yara Lamers through a matcha battle as they prepare to make Bobby Flay green with envy at their pastry prowess.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:
S36 E02 — Bring on the Brits!
Chef Michael Symon and Shark Tank's Robert Herjavec recruit chefs Poppy O'Toole and Joel Childs to master English specialties and match up against Bobby Flay in the competition.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:

Fashion icon Carson Kressley and pastry chef Stephanie Boswell zhuzh up chefs Chris Infinger and Kevin Lee and prepare them for victory over Bobby Flay.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:
S39 E05 — Ready for a Rematch?!
Chefs Poppy O'Toole and Mika Leon lost once to Bobby Flay, and they're back to ensure that doesn't happen again; Antonia Lofaso and Sophie Flay root them on from the sidelines.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:
S41 E07 — New York State of Grind
Hardcore New Yorkers Alex Guarnaschelli and comedian Desus Nice bring in chefs David Viana and Kess Eshun to kick Bobby Flay to the curb.

Henson challenges the remaining six bakers to face off in head-to-head matchups to create demon doll desserts, either Paris-Brest, baked cheesecake or Swiss roll; the winner of each matchup is safe, and the overall challenge winner receives $1,000.

description:
S12 E06 — Masters of the Macabre
In the semifinal haunted heat, John Henson asks the bakers to create macabre oil painting desserts inspired by creepy masterpieces; the bottom three bakers take on witchy desserts with edible candles to keep their flame alive in the competition.

title: The Ultimate Baking Championship
description:
S01 E03 — Pastry Cream Classics
Palmer challenges the nine chefs to face off in a showdown that tests their mastery of pastry cream; each chef must present their own interpretation of Boston cream pie, coconut cream pie or Italian rum cake to judges Duff Goldman and Shinmin Li.

title: The Ultimate Baking Championship
description:
S01 E04 — The Pastry Shop
Palmer divides the eight chefs into teams to craft laminated dough pastries worthy of display in a world-class pâtisserie case; each baker creates one sweet and one savory pastry for their team, hoping to impress judges Duff Goldman and Bryan Ford.

title: The Ultimate Baking Championship
description:
S01 E05 — Innovation
Jesse Palmer challenges the seven remaining chefs to find inspiration in grab-and-go gas station snacks; the bakers create their own interpretation of a classic dessert, like an opera cake or a Sachertorte, for judges Duff Goldman and Zac Young.

title: Flavortown Food Fight
description:
S01 E04 — Crunch Day
Mayor Guy Fieri is calling it Crunch Day in Flavortown; the returning winner faces off against chefs Josh Smith and Saba Duffy to impress judges Troy Johnson and Viet Pham with mind-blowingly crunchy bites worthy of scoring up to $20,000.

title: Flavortown Food Fight
description:
S01 E05 — Over-the-Top Day
The competition's first $20,000 prize winner is back to take on Michelle Wallace and Adam Greenberg in Guy Fieri's over-the-top challenge; judges Jet Tila and Jonathon Sawyer are on hand to taste the most bodacious dishes in Flavortown history.

title: Flavortown Food Fight
description:
S01 E06 — Cheese Day
Guy Fieri is challenging America's best chefs to compete in his ever-changing lineup of outside-the-box Flavortown restaurants, from food carts to fine dining; with $20,000 on the line, these chefs will need to be prepared for anything.

title: Flavortown Food Fight
description:
S01 E07 — Bowling Day
Fieri challenges the competitors to leave the plates behind and serve everything in a bowl; the returning champion takes on chefs Martel Stone and Evelyn Garcia to win over judges Antonia Lofaso and Aaron May in Flavortown's fiercest competition yet.

title: Chopped
description:
S56 E09 — Beef Knuckle Down
When the chefs get fried potatoes topped with Korean chile powder in the appetizer basket, the judges could be in for some fusion confusion or satisfying first plates; the competitors find a versatile, lean cut of meat in the entrée basket.

title: Chopped
description:
S58 E08 — Truffle Kerfuffle
Competitors race to turn mystery ingredients into extraordinary three-course meals; this competition is all about skill, speed and ingenuity and only one chef will impress the judges enough to survive the chopping block.

title: Chopped
description:
S62 E10 — Raclette Racket
Four brave chefs take on a cheese that won't melt and a clock that won't stop in the appetizer round; the chefs step it up in the entrée round with camel tenderloin before tackling a layered sweet and a tart berry in the dessert round.

title: Chopped
description:
S61 E11 — Midnight Snack Attack
This battle is all about indulging wholeheartedly in late-night cravings; in the first round, tacos and ramen in the basket force the chefs to make fusion plates; the entrée basket includes a very hot pepper and a beloved potato product.

title: Chopped
description:
S63 E10 — Seoul Searching
In the first round, four chefs with a deep love for Korean food get creative with a canned fish and a citrus compote; two popular Korean proteins are part of the puzzle in the entrée round.

description:

Katie Lee Biegel and David Burtka dial up the distractions while chefs Lambert Givens and Jesse Houston try to ring Bobby Flay's bell.

Eddie Jackson and Maneet Chauhan pull out all the stops to help chefs Bernard Bennett and Lena Le roll out a victory over Bobby Flay.

Antonia Lofaso and comedian Jay Pharoah recruit pasta pros Sasha Grumman and Zach Chancey to bring the heat against Bobby Flay.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:

Chef Geoffrey Zakarian and Entertainment Tonight anchor Nischelle Turner dig up the dirt on Bobby Flay to help chefs Arnold Myint and Emily Lim get red carpet ready.

Chopped grand champion Chef Sara Bradley is ready to bring her Jewish, Southern and Appalachian flavors to defeat Bobby Flay's Titans. New York Times food columnist Melissa Clark doles out the critiques.
